motion_rule: the tray slides her down the aisle to 6.45, then the seller strides on with her in the bag; counters, crates and ice sweep across the lens every beat; the camera tracks alongside at her level; new shot size each beat, never wider than her head filling a third of frame, one action per beat
character: a plump mackerel with a mirror-striped flank, upright on her tail, jaw working, eye always clear
second_characters: ONE heavy seller in a white cap and stained apron, gold teeth, striding from 6.45; ONE buyer, arms only, at 7.85
props: ONE price card reading 3999 in the ice beside her; A SWARM of grey salmon heads under a paper soup pot card; ONE paper bag; ONE fish bone behind his ear
prop_continuity: the heads lie under the soup pot card from 2.15; the bone leaves his ear at 8.55
environment: a fish hall, daylight from the roof, tiled counters and crates a fin away both sides, no far wall
light_events: flat white noon off the tiles, a mirror flash down her flank at 3.75, a gold glint at 9.40

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: a smug oily female voice, biting each word, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: prosh-LI, vre-me-NA, lo-SO-sya, te-PER, ma-YA, O-che-red, blis-TAT, BU-desh, KAZH-doy, KOS-toch-ke
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.90, 2.15-4.25 and 4.50-6.45 each one breath; after 6.45 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens wide and shapes every syllable
audio.sfx: ice crunching, trays scraping, crates banging, a scale clanging, a wet guffaw, a wet spit

timeline.a: the tray shoves off, she rears up off the ice, head to the lens
she rides the tray past a crate raking across behind her
her tail whips and hurls the grey salmon heads off the tray at the lens
the heads slap on the tile, he drops the soup pot card on them
she shoves the 3999 card upright with her nose
she throws her body over, the tray skidding under her
she rises on her tail, fins wide, crates banging past
she arcs her flank at the lens, light ripping down it
the tray hits a rut, ice jumping up around her
she leans in at the lens, jaw wide, the aisle tearing past
the tray slams through a rut, ice and water sheeting across the lens
she throws her flank at the lens, crates ripping past both sides
he sweeps across the frame, scoops her off the tray into the bag on the move, her head out the top
still walking he slaps the bag on the scales, needle whipping round, and hauls it on
he swings the bag into the buyer arms and snatches the banknotes out of them
walking on, he stuffs the money inside his apron against his chest and guffaws at the lens
he pulls the bone from behind his ear
he digs the bone between his gold teeth, spits past the lens and grins into it, she thrashing in the bag

must_appear: the 3999 card beside her to 6.45; at 1.25 her tail hurls the heads off the tray; every line is spoken, the last word by 6.45; he does not touch her before 6.45; from 6.45 the order runs bag, scales, banknotes, apron, guffaw, bone, teeth, spit, grin, one to a beat; he never stops walking; her head stays out of the bag, jaw working
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, cyrillic letters, words, a parked camera, a standing seller, a closed jaw while speaking, slow motion, an empty aisle, a far wall, a fish hidden in the bag, a word not in the lines
